# translationCore

> translationCore is a set of free, open-source tools from unfoldingWord that help churches and translation teams understand, translate, and check Scripture in their own languages. translationCore Desktop (Windows, Mac, and Linux) is a workspace to draft, check, align, and share a translation. translationCore Mobile (Android, iPhone, and the web) is for oral translation: record, listen back, and improve. Both work offline.

## Apps

- [translationCore Desktop](https://translationcore.com/desktop): An end-to-end workspace for Bible translation. Draft, check, align, and share a translation in one app. Works offline.
- [translationCore Mobile](https://translationcore.com/mobile): A simple app for oral translation. Record by book, chapter, and segment, listen back, fix, and share on a phone. Works offline.
- [Previous version](https://translationcore.com/previous-version): Downloads for the previous version of translationCore Desktop.

## Resources

- [Biblical Resources](https://translationcore.com/resources): Open-licensed Translation Notes, Translation Words, Translation Academy, Translation Questions, and source texts.
- [Training & Support](https://translationcore.com/training): Foundations BT, Church-Based Training, BT Servant, and Open Bible Stories.
- [translationCore Desktop help](https://translationcore.com/tc-help/): How to use translationCore Desktop.
